The stronger the flame, the tastier the dish!|Recipe Book|TotK}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Seafood Fried Rice can be made by [[Cooking]] [[Hylian Rice]], a piece of [[Rock Salt]], and either a [[Hearty Blueshell Snail]] or a [[Porgy]] in a [[Cooking Pot]]. To make the default version, [[Link]] must use two seafood [[Ingredient]]s with contradicting effects. When they are eaten, Link will have some of his [[Heart]]s restored to his [[Life Gauge]]. These [[Meal]]s are tastier when stronger [[Flames]] are used to cook them. Based on the type of seafood used, the three following variations of Seafood Fried Rice can be made: * '''Hearty Seafood Fried Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Seafood Fried Rice}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
Various seafood has been sautéed with rice. The stronger the flame, the tastier the dish!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using Hearty Blueshell Snails. These Meals will completely heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. * '''Mighty Seafood Fried Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Seafood Fried Rice}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
Various seafood has been sautéed with rice. The stronger the flame, the tastier the dish!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Mighty Porgy|Mighty Porgies]]. If eaten, Link will receive a boost to the power of his attacks. * '''Tough Seafood Fried Rice''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Seafood Fried Rice}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
Various seafood has been sautéed with rice. The stronger the flame, the tastier the dish!|Inventory|BotW}} Made by using [[Armored Porgy|Armored Porgies]]. Link can eat them to receive an increase to his defensive abilities. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} [[Link]] can make Seafood Fried Rice by [[Cooking]] either type of [[Porgy]] with [[Hylian Rice]] and a piece of [[Rock Salt]]. ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==See Also== {{See Also| * Food * Fried Egg and Rice * Meal * Seafood Rice Balls }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Fries, Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Seafood |items= BotW, TotK }}
